questions.prompt: Explain why a coil carrying current between the poles of a magnet starts to rotate.
questions.modelAnswer: The two long sides of the coil carry current in opposite directions. By Fleming’s left-hand rule, the magnetic field pushes one side up and the other side down. These two opposite forces form a turning effect (a couple) on the coil, so it rotates about its axis.
rubric: Opposite currents in the two sides
Turning effect makes the coil rotate
